objective: Teach BOOM Stylist and Merchandising UX how HUNT Cinematic lighting should support product visibility, hierarchy and mood in both light and dark themes.

layers.rule: World/category atmosphere only; never alter product truth or source photography.
Use depth, edge light and shadow to separate shelves/cards from the page without visual clutter.
Keep the media bay neutral and bright enough that product colors remain readable in light and dark modes.

hard_rules: Never apply opacity, blend modes or darkening filters that change source product photography.
Product media remains visually neutral in dark mode.
Light mode is off-white, not clinical pure white.
Lighting creates hierarchy, not fake product attributes.
Theme transitions behave like a lighting cue, not a hard flash.
Mobile uses reduced shadow/glow for performance and clarity.
Reduced-motion preference disables lighting transition animation.
stylist_use: Choose Hero products that remain readable under both themes.
Avoid shelves where every card has equal visual emphasis.
Use ambient category color only as a subtle context signal.
Keep one primary focal product per shelf or look.
Visual QA must check both themes before Owner Gate.
